'''Anne Canteaut''' is a French researcher in [[cryptography]], working at the [[French Institute for Research in Computer Science and Automation]] (INRIA) in Paris.  She studies the design and [[cryptanalysis]] of [[symmetric-key algorithm]]s and [[S-box]]es.

==Education and career==
Canteaut earned a diploma in engineering from [[ENSTA Paris]] in 1993.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ensta.org/fr/profil/anne.canteaut|title=Anne Canteaut|publisher=ENSTA Paris|accessdate=2020-10-14}}</ref> She completed her doctorate at [[Pierre and Marie Curie University]] in 1996, with the dissertation ''Attaques de cryptosystèmes à mots de poids faible et construction de fonctions t-résilientes'' supervised by {{ill|Paul Camion|fr}}.<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=143133}}</ref>

She is currently the chair of the INRIA Evaluation Committee,<ref>{{cite web |date=18 October 2022 |title=Inria Evaluation Committee |url=https://www.inria.fr/en/inria-evaluation-committee |access-date=26 December 2022 |website=[[French Institute for Research in Computer Science and Automation|Inria]]}}</ref> and of the [[International Association for Cryptologic Research|FSE]] steering committee.<ref>{{cite web |last=Knudsen |first=Lars R. |author-link=Lars Ramkilde Knudsen |date=21 December 2020 |title=Fast Software Encryption (FSE) |url=https://www.paris.inria.fr/secret/Anne.Canteaut/FSE/ |access-date=26 December 2022 |website=[[French Institute for Research in Computer Science and Automation|Inria]]}}</ref> She was the scientific leader of the INRIA team SECRET between 2007 and 2019.

==Cryptographic primitives==
Canteaut has contributed to the design of several new cryptographic primitives:
* [[DECIM]], a [[stream cipher]] submitted to the [[eSTREAM]] project<ref>{{cite conference|last1=Wu|first1=Hongjun|last2=Preneel|first2=Bart|editor-last=Robshaw|editor-first=Matthew J. B.|contribution=Cryptanalysis of the Stream Cipher DECIM|doi=10.1007/11799313_3|pages=30–40|publisher=Springer|series=Lecture Notes in Computer Science|title=Fast Software Encryption, 13th International Workshop, FSE 2006, Graz, Austria, March 15-17, 2006, Revised Selected Papers|volume=4047|year=2006|doi-access=free|isbn=978-3-540-36597-6 | chapter-url=https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.1007/11799313_3.pdf}}
</ref>
* [[SOSEMANUK]], a [[stream cipher]] selected in the [[eSTREAM]] portfolio<ref>{{cite conference|last1=Salehani|first1=Yaser Esmaeili|last2=Kircanski|first2=Aleksandar|last3=Youssef|first3=Amr M.|editor1-last=Nitaj|editor1-first=Abderrahmane|editor2-last=Pointcheval|editor2-first=David|contribution=Differential Fault Analysis of Sosemanuk|doi=10.1007/978-3-642-21969-6_20|pages=316–331|publisher=Springer|series=Lecture Notes in Computer Science|title=Progress in Cryptology - AFRICACRYPT 2011 - 4th International Conference on Cryptology in Africa, Dakar, Senegal, July 5-7, 2011. Proceedings|volume=6737|year=2011|isbn=978-3-642-21968-9 }}</ref>
* [[Shabal]], a [[hash function]] submitted to the [[SHA-3 competition]]<ref>{{cite conference|last1=Detrey|first1=Jérémie|last2=Gaudry|first2=Pierrick|last3=Khalfallah|first3=Karim|editor1-last=Biryukov|editor1-first=Alex|editor2-last=Gong|editor2-first=Guang|editor2-link=Guang Gong|editor3-last=Stinson|editor3-first=Douglas R.|contribution=A Low-Area Yet Performant FPGA Implementation of Shabal|doi=10.1007/978-3-642-19574-7_7|pages=99–113|publisher=Springer|series=Lecture Notes in Computer Science|title=Selected Areas in Cryptography - 17th International Workshop, SAC 2010, Waterloo, Ontario, Canada, August 12-13, 2010, Revised Selected Papers|volume=6544|year=2010|doi-access=free|isbn=978-3-642-19573-0 | chapter-url=https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.1007/978-3-642-19574-7_7.pdf}}</ref>
* [[Prince (cipher)|Prince]], a lightweight [[block cipher]]<ref>{{cite journal|last1=Soleimany|first1=Hadi|last2=Blondeau|first2=Céline|last3=Yu|first3=Xiaoli|last4=Wu|first4=Wenling|last5=Nyberg|first5=Kaisa|last6=Zhang|first6=Huiling|last7=Zhang|first7=Lei|last8=Wang|first8=Yanfeng|doi=10.1007/s00145-013-9175-4|issue=3|journal=J. Cryptol.|pages=718–744|title=Reflection Cryptanalysis of PRINCE-Like Ciphers|volume=28|year=2015|s2cid=253639057 |doi-access=free}}</ref>

==Recognition==
Canteaut was awarded the [[Legion of Honour]] in 2019.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/jorf/id/JORFTEXT000038759146|title=Décret du 13 juillet 2019 portant promotion et nomination|publisher=Government of France|date=13 July 2019}}</ref> She became a fellow of the [[International Association for Cryptologic Research]] in 2024.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://iacr.org/fellows/2024/canteaut.html|title=Anne CANTEAUT 2024 IACR Fellow|publisher=IACR}}</ref> She was elected a member of the [[French Academy of Sciences]] in 2025.<ref>{{cite web |title=Nouveaux membres élus à l'Académie de sciences : pour la première fois une majorité féminine |url=https://academie-sciences.prod.aa-testing.tech/sites/default/files/2024-12/Communiqu%C3%A9%20de%20presse_%20Elections%202024_3.pdf}}</ref>
